bookInfo.name: New History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷三 梁本紀第三: 末帝
title.en: Volume 3 Later Liang Annals 3: Later Emperors
title.raw: 卷三 梁本紀第三: 末帝 Volume 3 Later Liang Annals 3: Later Emperors

sentences.zh: 卷三 梁本纪第三

translations.literal: Volume Three — Basic Annals of Liang, Part Three.
translations.idiomatic: Volume 3: Later Liang Annals 3.

sentences.zh: 末帝，太祖第三子友贞也。

translations.literal: The Last Emperor was Youzhen, the third son of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor was Zhu Youzhen, Taizu’s third son.

sentences.zh: 为人美容貌，沈厚寡言，雅好儒士。

translations.literal: By nature he had a handsome countenance; he was deep, steady, and sparing of words, and from of old he favored Confucian scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He was handsome, reserved and taciturn, and had long cultivated the company of scholars.

sentences.zh: 太祖即位，封均王，为左天兴军使、东京马步军都指挥使。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne, he enfeoffed him Prince of Jun, and appointed him commissioner of the Left Heavenly Revival Army and overall commander of the eastern-capital horse and foot forces.
translations.idiomatic: After Taizu became emperor he made Youzhen Prince of Jun and named him commissioner of the Left Heavenly Revival Army and commander of all horse and foot troops at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 乾化二年六月，太祖遇弑，友珪自立，杀博王友文，以弑帝之罪归之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Qianhua, Taizu was assassinated; Yougui seized power himself, killed Prince of Bo Youwen, and laid the crime of regicide upon him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianhua 2 (912) Taizu was murdered. Yougui seized the throne, executed Prince of Bo Zhu Youwen, and blamed him for the assassination.

sentences.zh: 以王为东京留守、开封尹，敬翔为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事，户部尚书李振为崇政院使。

translations.literal: Youzhen was made eastern-capital regent and prefect of Kaifeng; Jing Xiang was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor; and Li Zhen, minister of revenue, was made commissioner of the Court of Esteemed Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen was appointed eastern-capital regent and Kaifeng prefect; Jing Xiang became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor; and Minister of Revenue Li Zhen became commissioner of the Court of Esteemed Governance.

sentences.zh: 明年，友珪改元曰凤历。

translations.literal: The next year Yougui changed the era name to Fengli.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Yougui adopted the reign title Fengli.

sentences.zh: 二月，驸马都尉赵岩至东都，王私与之谋，遣马慎交之魏州，见杨师厚计事。

translations.literal: In the second month, Imperial Son-in-law Commander Zhao Yan arrived at the eastern capital; Youzhen met with him in private to plot, and sent Ma Shenjiao to Weizhou to consult Yang Shihou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Imperial Son-in-law Commander Zhao Yan came to the eastern capital. Youzhen conferred with him in secret and sent Ma Shenjiao to Weizhou to win Yang Shihou to their cause.

sentences.zh: 师厚遣小校王舜贤至洛阳，告左龙虎统军袁象先使讨贼。

translations.literal: Shihou sent a junior officer, Wang Shunxian, to Luoyang to tell Yuan Xiangxian, commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, to raise troops against the usurper.
translations.idiomatic: Shihou dispatched a junior officer, Wang Shunxian, to Luoyang with orders for Yuan Xiangxian, commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, to march against the usurper.

sentences.zh: 是时怀州龙骧屯兵叛，方捕索之，王乃伪为友珪诏书，发左右龙骧在东都者皆还洛阳，因激怒之曰：「天子以怀州屯兵叛，追汝等欲尽坑之。

translations.literal: At that time the Longxiang garrison at Huaizhou had rebelled and was being hunted down; Youzhen then forged an edict in Yougui’s name ordering all Longxiang troops stationed at the eastern capital to return to Luoyang, and incited them, saying: “Because the Huaizhou garrison rebelled, the Son of Heaven is pursuing you and intends to bury you all alive.”
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Longxiang garrison at Huaizhou had mutinied and was being rounded up. Youzhen forged an edict in Yougui’s name recalling every Longxiang unit at the eastern capital to Luoyang, then told them: “The emperor, citing the mutiny at Huaizhou, is hunting you down to slaughter you to the last man.”

sentences.zh: 」诸将皆泣，莫知所为。

translations.literal: The generals all wept and knew not what to do.
translations.idiomatic: The officers broke down in tears, utterly at a loss.

sentences.zh: 王曰：「先皇帝经营王业三十餘年，今日尚为友珪所杀，汝等安所逃死乎！

translations.literal: Youzhen said: “The late emperor built up the royal enterprise for more than thirty years, and today he was still murdered by Yougui — where can you flee to escape death!”
translations.idiomatic: Youzhen said: “The late emperor spent more than thirty years building this dynasty, and Yougui has just murdered him. Where can any of you hope to live?”

sentences.zh: 」因出太祖画像示诸将而泣曰：「汝能趋洛阳擒逆贼，则转祸为福矣。

translations.literal: He then produced Taizu’s portrait, showed it to the generals, and wept, saying: “If you can hurry to Luoyang and seize the rebel, you will turn disaster into blessing.”
translations.idiomatic: He brought out Taizu’s portrait, wept before the troops, and said: “March on Luoyang, capture the usurper, and you will turn ruin into reward.”

sentences.zh: 」军士皆呼万岁，请王为主，王乃遣人趣象先等。

translations.literal: The soldiers all shouted “Long live the Son of Heaven!” and asked that Youzhen be their leader; he then sent men to urge on Xiangxian and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The men shouted their allegiance and begged Youzhen to lead them. He sent word urging Yuan Xiangxian and his allies to act.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，象先等以禁兵讨贼，友珪死，杜晓见杀。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Xiangxian and the others led the palace troops against the usurper; Yougui died, and Du Xiao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin Yuan Xiangxian led the palace guard against the usurper. Yougui was killed, and Du Xiao died with him.

sentences.zh: 象先遣赵岩持传国宝至东都，请王入洛阳，王报曰：「夷门，太祖所以兴王业也，北拒并汾，东至淮海，国家藩镇，多在东方，命将出师，利于便近。

translations.literal: Xiangxian sent Zhao Yan with the imperial seal to the eastern capital, asking Youzhen to enter Luoyang; Youzhen replied: “Yimen is where Taizu raised the royal enterprise — it faces Bing and Fen in the north and reaches to the Huai and sea in the east. Most of the realm’s military governors lie in the east; when generals take the field, proximity is an advantage.”
translations.idiomatic: Xiangxian sent Zhao Yan with the imperial seal to the eastern capital, inviting Youzhen to Luoyang. He answered: “Yimen is where Taizu founded the dynasty. It commands the north against Bing and Fen and the Huai and sea in the east. Most of our provinces lie eastward, and campaigns are easier when the court stays near the front.”

sentences.zh: 」是月，皇帝即位于东都，复称乾化三年，复博王友文官爵。

translations.literal: That month the emperor took the throne at the eastern capital, restored the era name to the third year of Qianhua, and restored Prince of Bo Youwen’s titles and offices.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor was enthroned at the eastern capital, revived the reign title Qianhua 3, and posthumously restored Prince of Bo Youwen’s honors.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未， 更名锽。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingwei, he changed his name to Huang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingwei, he adopted the taboo name Huang.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，杨师厚取沧州。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Yang Shihou took Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Yang Shihou captured Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋九月甲辰，御史大夫姚洎为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Gui was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Gui became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，晋人取幽州。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, the Jin took Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter Jin forces seized Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年夏四月丁丑，贬于兢为莱州司马。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the fourth year, on the day dingchou, Yu Jing was demoted to military adjutant of Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the fourth year, on the day dingchou, Yu Jing was demoted to military adjutant of Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 武宁军节度使蒋殷反，天平军节度使牛存节讨之。

translations.literal: Jiang Yin, military governor of the Wuning army, rebelled; Niu Cunjie, military governor of the Tianping army, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yin, military governor of Wuning, rebelled. Niu Cunjie, military governor of Tianping, marched against him.

sentences.zh: 贞明元年春正月，存节克徐州。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhenming, Cunjie took Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, Zhenming 1, Cunjie captured Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，赵光逢罢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Zhao Guangfeng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Zhao Guangfeng was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 平卢军节度使贺德伦为天雄军节度使，分其相、澶、卫州为昭德军，宣徽使张筠为节度使。

translations.literal: He Delun, military governor of the Pinglu army, was made military governor of the Tianxiong army; the prefectures of Xiang, Chan, and Wei were carved out as the Zhaode army, with Court Commissioner Zhang Yun as its military governor.
translations.idiomatic: He Delun of Pinglu was transferred to Tianxiong. Xiang, Chan, and Wei were split off as the new Zhaode circuit under Court Commissioner Zhang Yun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，天雄军乱，贺德伦叛附于晋。

translations.literal: On the day jichou the Tianxiong army mutinied, and He Delun rebelled and went over to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou the Tianxiong army mutinied; He Delun defected to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 邠州李保衡叛于岐，来附。

translations.literal: Li Baoheng of Binzhou rebelled against Qi and came over to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baoheng of Binzhou broke with Qi and submitted to Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月庚寅朔，晋王李存勖入于魏州，遂取德州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, gengyin, Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, entered Weizhou and then took Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, gengyin, Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, entered Weizhou and seized Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，康王友孜反，伏诛。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinhai, Prince of Kang Youzi rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinhai, Prince of Kang Youzi rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，改元。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yichou, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day yichou, the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 耀州温昭图叛于岐，来附。

translations.literal: Wen Zhaotu of Yaozhou rebelled against Qi and came over to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Zhaotu of Yaozhou broke with Qi and submitted to Liang.

sentences.zh: 是岁，更名瑱。

translations.literal: That year he changed his name again to Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: That year he adopted the taboo name Zhen.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月丙申，杨涉罢。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year, on the day bingshen, Yang She was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring, the second year, on the day bingshen, Yang She was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月，镇南军节度使刘掞及晋人战于故元城，败绩，奔于滑州。

translations.literal: In the third month, Liu Shan, military governor of the Zhennan army, fought the Jin at Old Yuancheng, was defeated, and fled to Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Liu Shan, military governor of Zhennan, met Jin forces at Old Yuancheng, was routed, and fled to Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 晋人取卫州、惠州。

translations.literal: The Jin took Weizhou and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces seized Weizhou and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 捉生都将李霸反，伏诛。

translations.literal: Li Ba, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ba, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，捉生都将张温叛降于晋。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Zhang Wen, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and surrendered to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer Zhang Wen, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, defected to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，晋人取相州，张筠奔于京师，安国军节度使阎宝叛附于晋。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Jin took Xiangzhou; Zhang Yun fled to the capital; and Yan Bao, military governor of the Anguo army, rebelled and went over to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the Jin took Xiangzhou. Zhang Yun fled to the capital, and Yan Bao, military governor of Anguo, defected to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，太子太保致仕赵光逢为司空兼门下侍郎、同中书门下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, Zhao Guangfeng, retired grand guardian of the heir apparent, was made minister of works and vice director of the Chancellery, co-equal grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, the retired grand guardian of the heir apparent Zhao Guangfeng became minister of works, vice director of the Chancellery, and co-equal grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 九月，晋人取沧州，横海军节度使戴思远奔于京师。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Jin took Cangzhou, and Dai Siyuan, military governor of the Henghai army, fled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jin forces captured Cangzhou. Dai Siyuan, military governor of Henghai, fled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 晋人克贝州，守将张源德死之。

translations.literal: The Jin took Beizhou, and the defending general Zhang Yuande died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin stormed Beizhou; its defender Zhang Yuande was killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，中书侍郎郑珏同中书门下平章事。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingyou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue was made co-equal grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingyou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue became co-equal grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 三年夏四月辛卯，右千牛卫大将军刘璩使于契丹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the third year, on the day xinmao, General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Liu Zan was sent as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the third year, on the day xinmao, General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Liu Zan was dispatched as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，宣义军节度使贺瑰为北面行营招讨使。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, He Gui, military governor of the Xuanyi army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter He Gui, military governor of Xuanyi, was appointed to command the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如西都卜郊。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he went to the western capital to divine the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he traveled to the western capital to perform the suburban oracle.

sentences.zh: 晋人取杨刘。

translations.literal: The Jin took Yangliu.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces seized Yangliu.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，不克郊，己卯，至自西都。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year he could not complete the suburban sacrifice; on the day jimao he returned from the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year the suburban rites were abandoned. On the day jimao he returned from the western capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，尚书吏部侍郎萧顷为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Xiao Qing, vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Vice Minister of Personnel Xiao Qing became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，赵光逢罢。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Zhao Guangfeng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Zhao Guangfeng was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚子朔，贺瑰杀其将谢彦章、孟审澄、侯温裕。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, gengzi, He Gui executed his generals Xie Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyü.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, gengzi, He Gui put his generals Xie Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyü to death.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，瑰及晋人战于胡柳，败绩。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Gui fought the Jin at Huliu and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai He Gui met Jin forces at Huliu and was routed.

sentences.zh: 是岁，泰宁军节度使张守进叛附于晋，亳州团练使刘寻阝为兖州安抚制置使以讨之。

translations.literal: That year Zhang Shoujin, military governor of the Taining army, rebelled and went over to the Jin; Liu Xun, prefect of Bozhou, was made pacification commissioner of Yanzhou to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhang Shoujin of Taining defected to the Jin. Liu Xun, prefect of Bozhou, was appointed pacification commissioner of Yanzhou to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，晋军于德胜。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, the Jin encamped at Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fifth year Jin forces encamped at Desheng.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未朔，开封尹王瓒为北面行营招讨使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the first day, yiwei, Wang Zan, prefect of Kaifeng, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month of autumn, yiwei, Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan was appointed to command the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，刘寻阝克兖州，张守进伏诛。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Liu Xun took Yanzhou, and Zhang Shoujin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Liu Xun captured Yanzhou and Zhang Shoujin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晋人取濮阳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Jin took Puyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Jin forces seized Puyang.

sentences.zh: 天平军节度使霍彦威为北面行营招讨使。

translations.literal: Huo Yanwei, military governor of the Tianping army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Yanwei, military governor of Tianping, was appointed to command the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 六年夏四月己亥，降死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the sixth year, on the day jihai, prisoners below the death penalty were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the sixth year, on the day jihai, sentences below death were commuted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尚书左丞李琪为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Li Qi, left vice director of the Secretariat, was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi Left Vice Director Li Qi became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 河中节度使朱友谦袭同州，杀其节度使程全晖，叛附于晋，泰宁军节度使刘寻阝讨之。

translations.literal: Zhu Youqian, military governor of the Hezhong army, raided Tongzhou, killed its military governor Cheng Quanhui, rebelled and went over to the Jin; Liu Xun, military governor of the Taining army, campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Youqian of Hezhong raided Tongzhou, killed its military governor Cheng Quanhui, and defected to the Jin. Liu Xun of Taining marched against him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，陈州妖贼母乙自称天子。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the sorcerer Mother Yi at Chenzhou proclaimed herself empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the Chenzhou sorcerer Mother Yi declared herself empress.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，供奉官郎公远为契丹欢好使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengyin, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was sent as envoy of cordial relations to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day gengyin, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was dispatched as envoy of friendship to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，母乙伏诛。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Mother Yi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Mother Yi was put to death.

sentences.zh: 龙德元年春，赵将张文礼杀其君镕来乞师，不许。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Longde, Zhao general Zhang Wenli killed his lord Rong and came begging for troops; the request was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, Longde 1, the Zhao general Zhang Wenli murdered his lord Wang Rong and asked for aid; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥朔，禁私度僧尼。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day, dinghai, private ordination of monks and nuns was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon dinghai, unauthorized ordination of monks and nuns was banned.

sentences.zh: 陈州刺史惠王友能反。

translations.literal: Prince of Hui Youneng, prefect of Chenzhou, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Hui Youneng, prefect of Chenzhou, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙戌朔，德音改元，降流罪已下囚。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the first day, bingxu, an edict of grace changed the era name and commuted sentences for exiles and below.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month of summer, bingxu, a general amnesty changed the reign title and commuted punishments through exile.

sentences.zh: 秋，赦友能，降封房陵侯。

translations.literal: In autumn Youneng was pardoned and demoted to Marquis of Fangling.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Youneng was pardoned and reduced to Marquis of Fangling.

sentences.zh: 天平军节度使戴思远为北面行营招讨使。

translations.literal: Dai Siyuan, military governor of the Tianping army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Siyuan of Tianping was appointed to command the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，思远及晋人战于戚城，败绩。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Siyuan fought the Jin at Qicheng and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Dai Siyuan met Jin forces at Qicheng and was routed.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，思远袭魏州，取成安。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, Siyuan raided Weizhou and took Cheng’an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year Dai Siyuan raided Weizhou and captured Cheng’an.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，滑州兵马留后段凝攻卫州，执其刺史李存儒。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Duan Ning, acting commander of the Huazhou forces, attacked Weizhou and captured its prefect Li Cunru.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Duan Ning, acting commander of the Huazhou garrison, attacked Weizhou and took its prefect Li Cunru prisoner.

sentences.zh: 戴思远克淇门、共城、新乡。

translations.literal: Dai Siyuan took Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Siyuan seized Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月，潞州李继韬叛于晋，来附。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the third year, Li Jitao of Luzhou rebelled against the Jin and came over to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring in the third year Li Jitao of Luzhou broke with the Jin and submitted to Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏闰四月，唐人取郓州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of summer the Tang took Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of summer Tang forces captured Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，宣义军节度使王彦章为北面行营招讨使，取德胜南城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Wang Yanzhang, military governor of the Xuanyi army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters and took the southern city of Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Wang Yanzhang of Xuanyi was appointed to command the northern campaign and recovered the southern citadel at Desheng.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，段凝为北面行营招讨使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Duan Ning was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Duan Ning was appointed to command the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 先锋将康延孝叛降于唐。

translations.literal: The vanguard general Kang Yanxiao rebelled and surrendered to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard commander Kang Yanxiao defected to Tang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，宣义军节度使王彦章及唐人战于中都，败绩，死之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiaxu, Wang Yanzhang, military governor of the Xuanyi army, fought the Tang at Zhongdu, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiaxu, Wang Yanzhang of Xuanyi met Tang forces at Zhongdu, was defeated, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 唐人取曹州。

translations.literal: The Tang took Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tang forces seized Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 盗窃传国宝奔于唐。

translations.literal: A thief stole the imperial seal and fled to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: A thief stole the imperial seal and fled to Tang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 梁亡。

translations.literal: Liang perished.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang dynasty fell.
